baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and strong baselines share carrier, substrate, seeds, perturbations, targets and parity order, and differ physically on the proposed population: discarded-seed canaries show reuse shipping exactly 17 units against cold 18 (L=2) and 19 (L=3) with distinct http/retrieval/verification profiles and disjoint phase/oplog structure (reuse: probe+guard+repair+4-task batch; cold: discovery+L observes+distill+5-task batch). There is no forced ceiling/floor: task success 1.0 on both arms is a functional gate only (never a decider), while the deciders are integer op ratios plus continuous dual-boundary wall-clock medians with live dynamic range (parent gaps 0.2-0.9ms on ~4ms medians, 1ns timer), so arms can cross in either direction. Cost-dimension completeness holds for the deciding surface: the shipped 4-field counter counts every scarce/billed op for BOTH arms (reuse <= cold on every field by protocol, so no cold-only cost is uncounted), the v4 inclusive boundary prices ALL residual scaffolding (registry build/scan/write, guard, repair-signal, arg deepcopy, distill) in time with no weight choice anywhere, the v3-exact boundary re-checks the same conclusion with the disclosed deepcopy-operand asymmetry removed, and the 5-field scaffold-op count - the one dimension where reuse is structurally worse (approx 27 vs approx 21-22) - is preregistered and reported as sensitivity rather than dropped: it is excluded from the classifier for the stated non-degeneracy arithmetic (deciding on it would make SUPPORTS unreachable; deciding on the shipped counter alone would make PRICED-DEFICIT unreachable), and its cost content is not lost because every scaffold op is already priced inside the inclusive latency boundary. No comparator dimension used by either arm is omitted from the joint decision surface.

control_sensitivity.reason: Positive and null controls discriminate under the same implementation that scores the experiment, verified by independent canaries on discarded seeds (untimed, no repair-vs-cold comparison): PC-BASE-LIVENESS pre-perturbation returned (200, verified=True) on all five resources; the unperturbed guard stayed silent (stale=false); NC-NO-PERTURBATION and NC-NOISE stayed silent under --liveness-only; NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR fired 4/4 unaffected resources for P1, P2 and P3 (gate is mean count > 0.10, so 4 clears it), and it also fires 4/4 when handed an UNPATCHED base mechanism, which proves V15's instrument-sensitivity gate is repair-independent and cannot mislabel a total repair failure as instrument death. Must-fail controls are structurally discriminative rather than tautological where it matters: B-LITERAL-REPLAY cannot succeed on a biting perturbation (P1 301 redirect, P3 403 missing consent header, P2 renamed-anchor postcondition verify-fail each break execute_batch), the pinned-module repair-signal probe patches True on P1/P2/P3 (positive side of the same mechanism), and the write-set/leakage instrument round-trips exactly under run_trial_v4's keying (0 diffs unpatched, 1 diff after a single patch). Every control failure policy is INVALID-not-negative, so an insensitive control can never be reported as a scientific negative. The only vacuous member is B-NO-REPAIR's success bit (hardcoded False in pinned v2 run_norepair), recorded as a nonblocking finding: it gates nothing, is excluded from the classifier by design, and the discriminating content (guard fires while the system abstains) is carried by norepair_guard_fired and V7.

nonblocking_findings: freeze_artifacts binding gap (completeness, not correctness): src/spider/__init__.py is executed in the import closure (importing spider.kernel runs the package __init__) but is not listed in spec.freeze_artifacts, and the spec freeze_eligibility.freeze_artifacts_bound reason therefore overstates 'no other mutable imports exist'. Product-lane packets bind it explicitly (e.g. EXP-PRODUCT-38186502935 six-file freeze) while prior runtime packets bound only the three carrier modules. Recommended at the next DESIGN revision: add src/spider/__init__.py to freeze_artifacts and soften the closure claim. Not blocking here because the module is a two-line re-export whose realistic mutation cannot change driver behavior, and a harmful edit fails loudly at import rather than producing a silent biased result.

V6/B-NO-REPAIR must-fail gate is vacuous: pinned v2 run_norepair hardcodes success=False, so 'M-NOREPAIR-SUCCESS > 0.10 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID' can never trip under any implementation. The control contributes only its guard-fired diagnostic and is excluded from the classifier by design (never a denominator), so no decision branch depends on it; consider grounding the gate on norepair_guard_fired >= 0.80 or relabeling the criterion as structural-by-construction.

Provenance wording in spec.freeze_eligibility.control_sensitivity says NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR was 're-fired at DESIGN under --liveness-only', but the --liveness-only path only re-fires unaffected_behavior, the contamination instrument and the two NCs; it never calls overbroad_contamination. The substance is supplied by this review's independent canary (overbroad_n=4 on P1/P2/P3, plus 4 with an unpatched mechanism), so the control is live - only the DESIGN provenance sentence is imprecise.

Decision-rule aggregate lists V3 (determinism-projection) and V10 (threshold-not-fitted) among runtime 'gates', but those are DESIGN/EXECUTE properties, not quantities the driver evaluates; likewise V1 freeze binding is enforced by EXECUTE's section-10 extraction check rather than by an in-driver refusal on runner_self_sha != CANONICAL. The self-sha is recorded in every output object, so audit can still detect drift post hoc. Not a reachability hole, but the spec text implies runtime enforcement that does not exist.

Asymmetric terminal precision (mandate-imposed, recorded so downstream does not over-read it): SUPPORTS requires all 12 strict inequalities (3 classes x 2 L x 2 latency boundaries) to hold, whereas a single noisy latency ratio >= 1.00 on any class/L/boundary converts to PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED under the mandate stop trigger with no further L-sweeps; bootstrap CIs (B_LAT=2000) are reported but not gated. This follows the director mandate verbatim and the honest prior (parent 36/36 signs against reuse) favors DROP, but a drop resting on a near-1.00 point median should be read with its CI, not as a high-precision refutation.

Informational arithmetic: functional_ok's Wilson bar is the binding constraint, so the effective repair bar is >= 11/12 (10/12 -> Wilson 0.552 < 0.60 even though 0.833 >= 0.80). Both pass and fail sides remain reachable; noted so AUDIT does not treat 10/12 as a functional pass.
rationale: Independent pre-freeze review (reviewer model opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free; DESIGN producer per model_design.json was opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free, so the independent-model rule holds). Every declared PASS in spec.freeze_eligibility was attacked with fresh, non-outcome-bearing probes rather than accepted: the frozen driver was re-extracted and its canonical hash reproduced, the pure classifier probe re-run (all 4+4 branches live, strict-inequality boundaries enforced), fresh-path liveness and NC silence re-executed, the exact frozen treatment episode smoke-run end-to-end on discarded seeds (repaired, shipped 17 with parent class vectors), cold nominals re-derived on discarded seeds (18/19, http 8/9 on all three classes), control canaries fired (PC all-five live, NC silent, overbroad 4/4 including unpatched-mech repair-independence, write-set round-trip 0/1), freeze artifacts re-hashed, and the driver's import/file-read closure audited to confirm no external bank or unlisted outcome-bearing file. The experiment is satisfiable (no missing prerequisite, treatment executable, controls discriminative, all gates attainable rather than guaranteed-to-trip) and identifiable (arms differ physically on ops and wall-clock, deciders have live dynamic range, the joint decision surface prices every cost dimension either comparator uses). What is disclosed as nonblocking: an unlisted but interpretation-inert src/spider/__init__.py in the import closure, one vacuous must-fail gate (B-NO-REPAIR), one overstated DESIGN provenance sentence (overbroad re-fire), two spec-vs-driver enforcement phrasings (V1/V3/V10 live in DESIGN/EXECUTE obligations, not in the driver), and the mandate-imposed asymmetry that a single near-1.00 latency ratio triggers the permanent-drop stop trigger while CIs are reported but not gated. None of these makes the packet incapable of answering its own question, so status is PASS with no blocking findings; spec and prereg were not edited.
